source.task_type: synthetic regression in a real repository

controlled.issue: SortedSet.add updates membership and length but leaves iteration and indexing stale.

direct_oracle_context.input: Issue plus the correct 40-line production window and verifier source.
direct_oracle_context.actions: One model response containing a structured exact edit; no tools.

tool_agent.input: Issue only, with full repository access through bounded tools.
tool_agent.actions: Agent must discover, search, read, edit, and test.

finding: Oracle-localized Direct is far cheaper when the correct context is already known. Tool Agent succeeds without localization hints, so its value must be measured on tasks where finding and validating the change is necessary.
limitations: Direct receives oracle-localized context, so this is a cost upper bound rather than an equal-information accuracy comparison.
